messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-23872 fired for prod-inference-cell-us-west-2 — inference queue length > 12k, 95p latency 2.4s, autoscaler attempts=8 failures=8.

pagerduty: Alert routed to eng-oncall.

maria-b: Acked PD-23872 :wave: Starting triage — checking autoscaler logs and recent deploys.

samuel: I see repeated ProvisioningFailed events from cloud provider: `quotaExceeded` on VM creation. Autoscaler keeps retrying but nodes never come up.

jen-s: If it's quota, manual node add won't help until infra gets quota bump. @ajay-k can you check provider quotas and any recent quota consumed?

ajay-k: On it. Cloud console shows vCPU quota for us-west-2 compute is at hard limit for our account. Opening emergency support case now. ETA for response usually 30-60m but will escalate.

maria-b: Meanwhile we need to reduce pressure. Propose: 1) throttle non-SLA tenants, 2) route low-priority requests to lower-cost/quantized model, 3) reduce batch sizes to decrease inflight. Can we do those quickly?

samuel: Attempted manual scale: `kubectl scale deployment inference-worker -n prod --replicas=120` but new pods stuck Pending; events show `FailedCreatePodSandBox` due to node provisioning errors. Queue probe:
```
curl -sS https://internal-metrics:9100/queues/prod | jq '.queue_length'
# 12423
```

infra-bot: Created support ticket CLOUD-9087 with cloud provider for quota increase; reference CLOUD-9087.

jen-s: I'll push a quick routing patch to send tier=free and tier=trial customers to `routed-model-small-v1` (quant8) as a fallback. Rolling canary to 10% now.

maria-b: Also applying emergency throttle on batch API: set `max_concurrency` from 200 -> 100 for user_tier=free via Console UI. That should reduce instantaneous inflight by ~30%.

samuel: Throttle applied. Observed queue drop: 12.4k -> 8.9k in ~4m. 95p latency dropped to ~1.6s. Still above our 95p SLO of 1.0s for premium customers, but critical failure mitigated for now.

ajay-k: Cloud support responded asking for justification; I've escalated to sales and account team for faster approval. Also enabling spot fallback pool (burst capacity) as stopgap — provisioning now.

maria-b: Good. Keep pagerduty updated. If queue creeps above 10k again, escalate PD to infra oncall. I'm going offline in 20m; will hand off to @ajay-k for follow-up/overnight watch if things remain stable.

ajay-k: Taking handoff. Monitoring alerting rules and will keep ops-channel and pagerduty-ops looped in. Tagging support leads: @jen-s @samuel.

incident-bot: Monitoring — next alert threshold queue_length > 10000.

maria-b: Thanks team :heart: — nice mitigation work. Leaving notes in the incident doc: https://internal/incident/PD-23872 (will update RCA if quota bump delayed).

samuel: Saving logs and snapshots for RCA. Snippet of autoscaler errors:
```
E0307 22:14:12 autoscaler.go:342] scale attempt failed: ProvisioningFailed: failed to create instance: quotaExceeded: "Requested vCPUs (48) exceed quota (40)"
E0307 22:14:48 autoscaler.go:342] retrying scale (attempt 6)
```

ajay-k: Cloud support acknowledged CLOUD-9087 and set priority P1. Meanwhile spot pool nodes are joining: 3/3 ready. Queue now ~6.2k and trending down. I will remain oncall.

pagerduty: PD-23872 acknowledged by maria-b, assigned to ajay-k for follow-up.

maria-b: Handing off to ajay-k for follow-up. If anything spikes, escalate to infra oncall and PD.

ajay-k: Got it — will monitor and update incident doc. If we reach full resolution (quota applied + autoscaler healthy), I'll close PD and post a brief postmortem tomorrow.

incident-bot: Thread note: active mitigation in place, not resolved."
